items.label: Cargo Height Limit
items.val: Must not exceed rider's shoulders (or total vehicle height 2.0 meters).

items.label: Cargo Width Limit
items.val: Must not extend beyond outer edge of handlebar by more than 10 cm.

items.label: Cargo Rear Extension
items.val: Must not extend beyond rear wheel axle by more than 50 cm (0.5 meters).

items.label: Heavy Motorcycle Cargo Weight
items.val: Max 80 kg.

items.label: Light Motorcycle Cargo Weight
items.val: Max 50 kg.

items.label: Small Light-Duty Motorcycle Weight
items.val: Max 70 kg or less (including battery).

items.label: Roads without signs/markings
items.val: Max 50 km/h.

items.label: Slow lane (separated fast/slow lanes)
items.val: Max 40 km/h.

items.label: Roads without lane lines / double yellow
items.val: Max 40 km/h (or 30 km/h on roads without broken yellow lines).

items.label: Approaching Railroad Level Crossing
items.val: Must reduce speed to 15 km/h or less.

items.label: Passing Distance between vehicles
items.val: At least 0.5 meters apart.

items.label: Distance from Parked Vehicles
items.val: Maintain at least 1.0 meter (width of a car door).

items.label: Prohibited Stopping Distance
items.val: Within 10 meters of intersections, bus stops, or fire hydrants.

items.label: Legal Breath Alcohol (BAC) Limit
items.val: 0.15 mg/L (or 0.03% blood alcohol).

items.label: First Drunk Driving Offense
items.val: Fine NT$15,000–90,000, 1–2 year license suspension, 2-year plate suspension.

items.label: 2nd Offense within 10 years
items.val: Fine NT$90,000, 3-year license revocation, mandatory safety course.

items.label: Refusing Sobriety Test
items.val: Fine NT$180,000, license revocation, vehicle impounded.

items.label: Vehicle Owner Liability
items.val: If owner knowingly allows drunk riding, motorcycle license plate suspended for 2 years.

items.label: Running a Red Light
items.val: Fine NT$1,800–5,400 + 3 demerit points.

items.label: Using Handheld Phone while Riding
items.val: Fine NT$1,000.

items.label: 12 Demerit Points in 1 Year
items.val: 2-month license suspension.

items.label: Accumulating Demerit Points after 2 Suspensions
items.val: Driving license Revocation.

items.label: Temporary Parking Rules
items.val: Max 3 minutes, driver ready to move vehicle at any time.

items.label: Signal Before Turning
items.val: Turn on turn signal at least 30 meters before turning/changing lanes.

items.label: Min Tire Tread Depth
items.val: Must be at least 1.0 mm (replace when aligned with wear indicator).

items.label: Tire Age Limit
items.val: Recommended replacement within 6 years of manufacture.

items.label: Helmet Requirements
items.val: Must have BSMI certification label, fit properly, chinstrap fastened tightly under chin. Must replace after heavy impact.

items.label: Horn Usage Rule
items.val: Each tap max 0.5 seconds, max 3 consecutive taps.

items.label: Passengers
items.val: Max 1 passenger on heavy/ordinary light motorcycles with fixed rear seat. NO side-saddle riding. Small light motorcycles: NO passengers.

items.label: CPR Compression-to-Ventilation Ratio
items.val: 30 compressions : 2 breaths.

items.label: CPR Compression Rate & Depth
items.val: At least 100 compressions/min, depth at least 5 cm on central sternum.

items.label: Brain Damage Window
items.val: Brain damage occurs within 4 to 6 minutes of cardiac/respiratory arrest.

items.label: Evaluation Interval during CPR
items.val: Check pulse/breathing every 2 minutes.

items.label: Spinal Injury Airway Clear
items.val: Use Jaw-thrust maneuver (do NOT tilt head).

items.label: Heimlich Maneuver Position
items.val: Place fist between navel and sternum.
